name: bee-api-vercel-guard
description: Deliberately empty — this file's only job is to stop Vercel's monorepo build-command detection from climbing up to the repo root's package.json (whose "build" script builds the Next.js frontend, not this Python backend) when deploying apps/api as its own project. Do not add a "scripts.build" entry here; let Vercel's Python/FastAPI framework detection handle the build.
